verdict.rationale: Gusto's platform overview lists "Generate payroll reports" as a payroll capability, so reporting is documented. Nothing describes payroll registers, gross-to-net breakdowns, or export formats. The payroll-retrieval API is only a developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented payroll register report, gross-to-net report detail, export formats (CSV/Excel), any hands-on or independent corroboration of reporting.
